dedupe_keys.name: land cover map of andorra 2012 mapa de cobertes del sol d andorra

description: The 2012 land cover map of Andorra shows land cover in the principality in twelve categories, digitised by photo-interpretation of the 2012 RGB and near-infrared orthophotographs (0.25 metre resolution) supplied by the cartography and topography area of the Government of Andorra. It follows the method of the 1995 land cover map made by CREAF and published by the Institut d'Estudis Andorrans in 2001, and the legend used for the 1972 and 1995 maps, so the three can be compared. Photo-interpretation was done at scales of 1:1,600 to 1:1,800 for display at 1:5,000, and the attributes are the land cover type, the perimeter and the area of each polygon. The map was converted from MiraMon to shapefile and is offered as a MiraMon GIS file (17 MB), an ArcGIS file (23 MB) and a JPG image (10 MB), made by CENMA of the Institut d'Estudis Andorrans. Access is free by download; the site carries a Government of Andorra copyright and no open licence. Caveats: the map shows 2012 and has not been updated on the page read, and the page is in Catalan. Coverage is Andorra. It supports hazard exposure analysis in a mountain country, such as avalanches, floods and wildfire near roads and settlements, and green infrastructure planning; related records are the HSY Helsinki region land cover and the Global Urban Tree LAI dataset.
